nodes.name: power_3v3_pri
nodes.description: Primary side 3.3V LDO regulator using XC6206 (U1). Steps VIN_5V down to VCC_3V3. VSS connects to GND. VOUT provides VCC_3V3 rail for MCU and primary side of isolators. Input and output require bypass capacitors. This module is the sole provider of VCC_3V3.

nodes.name: power_3v3_iso
nodes.description: Isolated side 3.3V LDO regulator using XC6206 (U2). Steps ISO_5V down to VCC_3V3_ISO. Ground reference is ISO_GND. VOUT provides VCC_3V3_ISO rail for ADC and isolated side of isolators. Input and output require bypass capacitors. This module is the sole provider of VCC_3V3_ISO.
3.3V LDO for isolated-side digital supply

nodes.name: iso_barrier
nodes.description: Galvanic isolation barrier using two ISO7721 dual-channel isolators (U4, U5). Provides 4 isolated channels for SPI (SCK, CS, MOSI, MISO). Side 1 (Primary) powered by VCC_3V3 and GND. Side 2 (Isolated) powered by VCC_3V3_ISO and ISO_GND. Signal direction must be configured to match SPI flow (3 channels PRI->ISO, 1 channel ISO->PRI). No direct electrical connection between GND and ISO_GND within this module.
Dual-channel digital isolator

nodes.name: adc_iso
nodes.description: ADS1118 16-bit SPI ADC (U6) on isolated side. Powered by VCC_3V3_ISO and ISO_GND. Receives SPI commands (SCLK, CS, DIN) from isolator. Sends conversion data (DOUT) to isolator. AIN0-3 available for sensing; AIN0 designated for REF5050 input. VDD pin connects to VCC_3V3_ISO. GND pin connects to ISO_GND.
16-bit SPI ADC on isolated side
